Hello everyone, I'm Antsa, a math PhD candidate at Clemson University. My research area is in multivariate cryptography, and I'm also getting my graduate certificate in Engineering and Science Education. I am currently taking a class on Computer-Assisted Proofs and decided to create a Mathematical Cryptography game in Lean 4. Dubinsky's work on ISETL inspired the game's structure, which utilizes the APOS framework and provides evidence to help students learn algebra more effectively. The goal is to learn Lean and mathematical cryptography simultaneously. No prior experience on Lean or cryptography needed. I have used GLM & Claude Cowork to help me build the game and am currently going through every detail. My focus now is on making sure everything works accurately; then when that's done, I'll add more content. I'd like to get some feedback from you on the math, the content, and the proofs. You can click here to test the game.

#cryptography #apos #multivariate-crypto
